    32	/-- Parameters for the `(m,q,d)` low individual degree test.
    33	
    34	Besides the usual positivity assumptions, we bundle the paper-faithful witness
    35	that `q = p^n` is a prime power. -/
    36	structure Parameters where
    37	  m : ℕ
    38	  q : ℕ
    39	  d : ℕ
    40	  hm : 0 < m
    41	  /-- Kept as a compatibility field so existing positivity proofs can continue
    42	  to use `params.hq`; it is derivable from `hqPrimePower`. -/
    43	  hq : 0 < q
    44	  /-- Paper-faithful witness that `q` is a prime power. -/
    45	  hqPrimePower : ∃ p n, Nat.Prime p ∧ 0 < n ∧ q = p ^ n
    46	
    47	deriving instance DecidableEq for Parameters
    48	
    49	namespace Parameters
    50	
    51	/-- Any number presented as a prime power is automatically positive. -/
    52	theorem q_pos_of_primePower {q : ℕ}
    53	    (hqPrimePower : ∃ p n, Nat.Prime p ∧ 0 < n ∧ q = p ^ n) : 0 < q := by
    54	  rcases hqPrimePower with ⟨p, n, hp, hn, rfl⟩
    55	  exact Nat.pow_pos hp.pos
    56	
    57	/-- Prime numbers are prime powers of exponent `1`. -/
    58	theorem prime_primePower {q : ℕ} (hqPrime : Nat.Prime q) :
    59	    ∃ p n, Nat.Prime p ∧ 0 < n ∧ q = p ^ n := by
    60	  exact ⟨q, 1, hqPrime, by decide, by simp⟩
    61	
    62	/-- Build parameters from explicit prime-power data `q = p^n`. -/
    63	def ofPrimePower (m q d p n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hn : 0 < n)
    64	    (hq : q = p ^ n) : Parameters :=
    65	  { m := m
    66	    q := q
    67	    d := d
    68	    hm := hm
    69	    hq := q_pos_of_primePower ⟨p, n, hp, hn, hq⟩
    70	    hqPrimePower := ⟨p, n, hp, hn, hq⟩ }
    71	
    72	/-- Build parameters when `q` itself is prime. -/
    73	def ofPrime (m q d : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hqPrime : Nat.Prime q) : Parameters :=
    74	  { m := m
    75	    q := q
    76	    d := d
    77	    hm := hm
    78	    hq := hqPrime.pos
    79	    hqPrimePower := prime_primePower hqPrime }
    80	
    81	/-- Convenience constructor for the ubiquitous binary field. -/
    82	def ofTwo (m d : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : Parameters :=
    83	  ofPrime m 2 d hm Nat.prime_two
    84	
    85	/-- Paper finite fields have at least two elements: `q = p^n` with `p` prime
    86	and `0 < n` (see `preliminaries.tex`, lines 17--19 and 89--93). -/
    87	theorem two_le_q (params : Parameters) : 2 ≤ params.q := by
    88	  obtain ⟨p, n, hp, hn, hq⟩ := params.hqPrimePower
    89	  rw [hq]
    90	  exact le_trans hp.two_le (Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hn) p)
    91	
    92	/-- The field-size parameter is strictly larger than `1`. -/
    93	theorem one_lt_q (params : Parameters) : 1 < params.q :=
    94	  lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two params.two_le_q
    95	
    96	/-- Positivity of the field-size parameter after casting to the repository's
    97	real-valued error scalar type. -/
    98	theorem q_cast_pos (params : Parameters) : 0 < (params.q : Error) :=
    99	  Nat.cast_pos.mpr params.hq
   100	
   101	end Parameters
   102	
   103	instance : Inhabited Parameters where
   104	  default := Parameters.ofTwo 1 0 (by decide)
   105	
   106	/-- The successor test obtained by appending one coordinate. -/
   107	def Parameters.next (params : Parameters) : Parameters :=
   108	  { m := params.m + 1
   109	    q := params.q
   110	    d := params.d
   111	    hm := Nat.succ_pos _
   112	    hq := params.hq
   113	    hqPrimePower := params.hqPrimePower }
   114	
   115	namespace Parameters
   116	
   117	/-- The predecessor parameters obtained by removing the last coordinate from a
   118	non-base ambient dimension.
   119	
   120	This is the inverse construction to `Parameters.next` on the data fields.  The
   121	proof fields are inherited from the original parameter bundle, so the inverse is
   122	propositional rather than definitional. -/
   123	def previous (params : Parameters) (hm : 1 < params.m) : Parameters :=
   124	  { m := params.m - 1
   125	    q := params.q
   126	    d := params.d
   127	    hm := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hm
   128	    hq := params.hq
   129	    hqPrimePower := params.hqPrimePower }
   130	
   131	/-- Removing the last coordinate and then applying `Parameters.next` recovers the
   132	original non-base parameters. -/
   133	theorem previous_next_eq (params : Parameters) (hm : 1 < params.m) :
   134	    (previous params hm).next = params := by
   135	  cases params with
   136	  | mk m q d hm0 hq hqPrimePower =>
   137	      have hsub : m - 1 + 1 = m := Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt hm)
   138	      simp [previous, Parameters.next, hsub]
   139	
   140	/-- A bundled predecessor for a parameter set known to be a successor dimension. -/
   141	structure SuccessorDecomposition (params : Parameters) where
   142	  /-- The predecessor parameter bundle. -/
   143	  pred : Parameters
   144	  /-- The predecessor's successor is the original parameter bundle. -/
   145	  next_eq : pred.next = params
   146	
   147	/-- Every parameter bundle of dimension strictly larger than one has a bundled
   148	predecessor whose successor is propositionally equal to the original bundle. -/
   149	def successorDecompositionOfOneLtM (params : Parameters) (hm : 1 < params.m) :
   150	    SuccessorDecomposition params where
   151	  pred := previous params hm
   152	  next_eq := previous_next_eq params hm
   153	
   154	/-- A positive dimension that is not the base dimension is strictly larger than
   155	one. -/
   156	theorem one_lt_m_of_ne_one (params : Parameters) (hm_ne_one : params.m ≠ 1) :
   157	    1 < params.m :=
   158	  lt_of_le_of_ne params.hm (Ne.symm hm_ne_one)
   159	
   160	/-- Non-base parameters have a bundled predecessor decomposition. -/
   161	def successorDecompositionOfNeOne (params : Parameters) (hm_ne_one : params.m ≠ 1) :
   162	    SuccessorDecomposition params :=
   163	  successorDecompositionOfOneLtM params (one_lt_m_of_ne_one params hm_ne_one)
   164	
   165	end Parameters
   166	
   167	instance {params : Parameters} : NeZero params.q :=
   168	  ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt params.hq⟩
   169	
   170	abbrev Fq (params : Parameters) := Fin params.q
   171	abbrev Point (params : Parameters) := Fin params.m → Fq params
   172	abbrev PointTuple (params : Parameters) (k : ℕ) := Fin k → Fq params
   173	
   174	instance {params : Parameters} : Inhabited (Fin params.m) :=
   175	  ⟨⟨0, params.hm⟩⟩
   176	
   177	instance {params : Parameters} : Inhabited (Fq params) :=
   178	  ⟨⟨0, params.hq⟩⟩
   179	
   180	/-- Prime-power metadata extracted from `params.hqPrimePower`, exposing the
   181	honest finite-field carrier `GaloisField p n` underlying the paper's notation
   182	`F_q`. -/
   183	structure PrimePowerFieldSpec (params : Parameters) where
   184	  p : ℕ
   185	  n : ℕ
   186	  pPrime : Nat.Prime p
   187	  nPos : 0 < n
   188	  cardEq : params.q = p ^ n
   189	
   190	/-- Recover the prime-power specification bundled inside `Parameters`. -/
   191	noncomputable def Parameters.primePowerFieldSpec
   192	    (params : Parameters) : PrimePowerFieldSpec params :=
   193	  have : Nonempty (PrimePowerFieldSpec params) := by
   194	    obtain ⟨p, n, hp, hn, hq⟩ := params.hqPrimePower
   195	    exact ⟨{
   196	      p := p
   197	      n := n
   198	      pPrime := hp
   199	      nPos := hn
   200	      cardEq := hq
   201	    }⟩
   202	  this.some
   203	
   204	/-- An honest finite field of order `q`, obtained from the prime-power
   205	witness bundled in `Parameters`. -/
   206	noncomputable abbrev HonestFq (params : Parameters) (spec : PrimePowerFieldSpec params) :=
   207	  letI : Fact spec.p.Prime := ⟨spec.pPrime⟩
   208	  GaloisField spec.p spec.n

   212	class FieldModel (q : ℕ) where
   213	  K : Type*
   214	  instField : Field K
   215	  instFintype : Fintype K
   216	  instDecidableEq : DecidableEq K
   217	  equiv : K ≃ Fin q

     6	/-!
     7	# The low-degree game
     8	
     9	This file introduces the finite question and answer alphabets used by the
    10	low-degree component of the Pauli basis test.  The maps are explicit maps on
    11	the ambient coefficient space, and their conditional-linearity levels are
    12	established below; the line-point distributions they induce are analysed in
    13	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean`.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	The source-facing nodes are `def:ld-game`, `def:ld-question-distribution`, and
    18	`def:ld-win-predicate` in
    19	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`; their paper origin is
    20	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	open scoped BigOperators
    24	
    25	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    26	
    27	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-- Numerical parameters for the low-degree game.  The ambient coefficient
    32	space uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq`, rather than a
    33	model supplied by each parameter record.  This is the Lean carrier for
    34	`def:ld-game` in
    35	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, with paper origin
    36	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    37	-/
    38	structure LdParams where
    39	  q : ℕ
    40	  m : ℕ
    41	  d : ℕ
    42	  k : ℕ
    43	  hm : 1 ≤ m
    44	  hd : 1 ≤ d
    45	  hk : 1 ≤ k
    46	  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
    47	  hdvd : m ∣ q
    48	
    49	/-- The positive dimension in `LdParams` supplies the finite coordinate type
    50	used by the uniform axis and prefix-index marginals. -/
    51	instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
    52	  ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩
    53	
    54	/-- The fixed model accessor for an `LdParams` record.  It is a compatibility
    55	view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently quantified
    56	parameter.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    57	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    58	-/
    59	noncomputable def LdParams.model (P : LdParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
    60	  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
    61	
    62	/-- The scalar carrier selected by an `LdParams` record; this is the fixed
    63	field carrier in `def:ld-game`, selected globally by `LdParams.model`.
    64	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    65	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    66	-/
    67	abbrev ScalarQ (P : LdParams) := (P.model).K
    68	
    69	/-- The three low-degree question types of `def:ld-game`, blueprint
    70	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    71	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    72	-/
    73	inductive LdType where
    74	  | point
    75	  | aline
    76	  | dline
    77	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
    78	
    79	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    80	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    81	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    82	-/
    83	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
    84	
    85	/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    86	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    87	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    88	-/
    89	abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
    90	
    91	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    92	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    93	-/
    94	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
    95	  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
    96	
    97	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
    98	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    99	-/
   100	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
   600	/-- The diagonal line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   601	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   602	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   603	-/
   604	def dlinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   605	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   606	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   607	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   608	    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
   609	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   610	
   611	/-- The low-degree consistency predicate, rejecting answers of the wrong
   612	constructor shape.  This is `def:ld-win-predicate` in
   613	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   614	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   615	-/
   616	noncomputable def ldWinPredicate (P : LdParams) :
   617	    LdQuestion P → LdQuestion P → LdAnswer P → LdAnswer P → Bool :=
   618	  open Classical in
   619	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   620	      if validLdAnswer tA a && validLdAnswer tB b then
   621	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   622	        | .point, .point, .pointVals u, .pointVals v => decide (u = v)
   623	        | .aline, .point, .alinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   624	            decide (alinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   625	        | .point, .aline, .pointVals u, .alinePolys f =>
   626	            decide (alinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   627	        | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   628	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   629	        | .point, .dline, .pointVals u, .dlinePolys f =>
   630	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   631	        | .aline, .aline, .alinePolys f, .alinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   632	        | .dline, .dline, .dlinePolys f, .dlinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   633	        | _, _, _, _ => true
   634	      else false
   635	
   636	/-- The low-degree game packaged as a `Game`.  This is `def:ld-game` in
   637	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, paper origin
   638	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   639	-/
   640	noncomputable def ldGame (P : LdParams) : Game where
   641	  QuestionA := LdQuestion P
   642	  QuestionB := LdQuestion P
   643	  AnswerA := LdAnswer P
   644	  AnswerB := LdAnswer P
   645	  μ := ldQuestionDistribution P
   646	  μ_prob := by
   647	    exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
   648	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P)) _
   649	  decide := ldWinPredicate P
   650	
   651	end
   652	
   653	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     7	
     8	The definitions are the finite-dimensional forms of `def:consistency` and
     9	`def:strategy-distance` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-237`,
    10	from `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-288`.

    15	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

    19	/-- The off-diagonal defect in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    20	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    21	noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    22	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    24	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    25	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    26	  avgOver μ (fun x =>
    27	    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
    28	      if a = b then 0 else
    29	        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
    30	          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)
    31	
    32	/-- A uniform consistency defect is invariant under a bijective relabeling of
    33	its question type. -/
    34	theorem consistencyDefect_uniform_question_equiv
    35	    {X Y Outcome iota : Type*}
    36	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
    37	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    38	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    39	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    40	    (e : X ≃ Y) (A B : Y → Outcome → Op iota)
    41	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
    42	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
    43	        (fun x a => A (e x) a) (fun x a => B (e x) a) psi =
    44	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi := by
    45	  unfold consistencyDefect
    46	  simpa using avgOver_uniform_equiv e (fun x =>
    47	    ∑ a : Outcome, ∑ b : Outcome,
    48	      if a = b then 0 else
    49	        (inner ℂ psi ((EuclideanSpace.equiv iota ℂ).symm
    50	          (((A (e x) a) * (B (e x) b)).mulVec psi))).re)
    51	
    52	/-- A consistency defect is invariant under a bijective relabeling of both
    53	outcome families. -/
    54	theorem consistencyDefect_outcome_equiv
    55	    {X Alpha Beta iota : Type*}
    56	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    57	    [Fintype Alpha] [DecidableEq Alpha]
    58	    [Fintype Beta] [DecidableEq Beta]
    59	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    60	    (mu : Distribution X) (e : Beta ≃ Alpha)
    61	    (A B : X → Alpha → Op iota) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
    62	    consistencyDefect mu
    63	        (fun x b => A x (e b)) (fun x b => B x (e b)) psi =
    64	      consistencyDefect mu A B psi := by
    65	  unfold consistencyDefect
    66	  apply avgOver_congr
    67	  intro x
    68	  let term : Alpha → Alpha → ℝ := fun a b =>
    69	    if a = b then 0 else
    70	      (inner ℂ psi ((EuclideanSpace.equiv iota ℂ).symm
    71	        (((A x a) * (B x b)).mulVec psi))).re
    72	  calc
    73	    _ = ∑ a : Beta, ∑ b : Beta, term (e a) (e b) := by
    74	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    75	      intro a _
    76	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    77	      intro b _
    78	      unfold term
    79	      by_cases hab : a = b
    80	      · subst b
    81	        simp
    82	      · have heab : e a ≠ e b := fun h => hab (e.injective h)
    83	        simp [hab, heab]
    84	    _ =
    85	        ∑ a : Beta, ∑ b : Alpha, term (e a) b := by
    86	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    87	      intro a _
    88	      exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun b => term (e a) b)
    89	    _ = ∑ a : Alpha, ∑ b : Alpha, term a b :=
    90	      Equiv.sum_comp e (fun a => ∑ b : Alpha, term a b)
    91	    _ = _ := rfl
    92	
    93	/-- Simultaneous bijective relabeling of uniform questions and outcomes leaves
    94	the consistency defect unchanged. -/
    95	theorem consistencyDefect_uniform_question_outcome_equiv
    96	    {X Y Alpha Beta iota : Type*}
    97	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
    98	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    99	    [Fintype Alpha] [DecidableEq Alpha]
   100	    [Fintype Beta] [DecidableEq Beta]
   101	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   102	    (questionEquiv : X ≃ Y) (outcomeEquiv : Beta ≃ Alpha)
   103	    (A B : Y → Alpha → Op iota) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   104	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   105	        (fun x b => A (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b))
   106	        (fun x b => B (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b)) psi =
   107	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi := by
   108	  calc
   109	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   110	        (fun x b => A (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b))
   111	        (fun x b => B (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b)) psi =
   112	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   113	        (fun x a => A (questionEquiv x) a)
   114	        (fun x a => B (questionEquiv x) a) psi :=
   115	      consistencyDefect_outcome_equiv (uniformDistribution X)
   116	        outcomeEquiv _ _ psi
   117	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi :=
   118	      consistencyDefect_uniform_question_equiv questionEquiv A B psi
   119	
   120	/-- Pointwise equality of both operator families gives equality of their
   121	consistency defects. -/
   122	theorem consistencyDefect_congr
   123	    {X Outcome iota : Type*}
   124	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
   125	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   126	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   127	    (mu : Distribution X) (A A' B B' : X → Outcome → Op iota)
   128	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota)
   129	    (hA : ∀ x a, A x a = A' x a) (hB : ∀ x a, B x a = B' x a) :
   130	    consistencyDefect mu A B psi = consistencyDefect mu A' B' psi := by
   131	  unfold consistencyDefect
   132	  apply avgOver_congr
   133	  intro x
   134	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   135	  intro a _
   136	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   137	  intro b _
   138	  by_cases hab : a = b
   139	  · simp [hab]
   140	  · simp only [hab, if_false]
   141	    rw [hA x a, hB x b]

   143	/-- The quantitative relation in `def:consistency`, blueprint
   144	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
   145	def IsConsistentWithin {X α ι : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   147	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   148	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
   149	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
   150	  consistencyDefect μ A B ψ ≤ δ

   152	/-- Unit-alphabet specialization of `def:povm-distance`, blueprint
   153	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
   154	noncomputable def opDistSq {X ι : Type*}
   155	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   156	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
   157	  opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ
   158	
   159	/-- The unit-alphabet operator distance equals its one-outcome family form from
   160	`def:povm-distance`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper
   161	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
   162	theorem opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq {X ι : Type*}
   163	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   164	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   165	    opDistSq μ M N ψ = opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x)
   166	      (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ := rfl
   167	
   168	/-- The strategy-distance relation `def:strategy-distance`. The two strategies'
   169	local Hilbert spaces are identified, and both measurement distances are
   170	evaluated on the first strategy's state. Blueprint
   171	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
   172	structure AreCloseStrategies (G : Game) (S S' : Strategy G) (δ : ℝ) : Prop where
   173	  /-- Identification of Alice's local Hilbert spaces. -/
   174	  hA : S.ιA = S'.ιA
   175	  /-- Identification of Bob's local Hilbert spaces. -/
   176	  hB : S.ιB = S'.ιB
   177	  state : stateDistSq S.ψ (reindexState
   178	      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.cast hA).symm (Equiv.cast hB).symm) S'.ψ) ≤ δ
   179	  alice : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.fst)
   180	      (fun x a => heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1)
   181	      (fun x a => heteroKron (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hA) ((S'.A x).effect a)) 1)
   182	      S.ψ ≤ δ
   183	  bob : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.snd)
   184	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b))
   185	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hB) ((S'.B y).effect b)))
   186	      S.ψ ≤ δ

    18	/-- The SWAP reindexing on `ι × ι`: permutes the two tensor factors.
    19	`swapDensity M (i₁,i₂) (j₁,j₂) = M (i₂,i₁) (j₂,j₁)`. -/
    20	def swapDensity {ι : Type*} (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ι × ι)) :

    24	/-- `swapDensity` is equal to reindexing by the product-commutation equivalence. -/

    77	/-- Post-process the outcomes of a submeasurement. The processed operator at `b` is the
    78	sum of the operators of all `a` with `f a = b`. -/
    79	noncomputable def postprocess {α β : Type*} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    80	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    81	    (A : SubMeas α ι) (f : α → β) :
    82	    SubMeas β ι where
    83	  outcome := fun b =>
    84	    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), A.outcome a
    85	  total := A.total
    86	  outcome_pos := fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => A.outcome_pos a
    87	  sum_eq_total := (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f A.outcome).trans A.sum_eq_total
    88	  total_le_one := A.total_le_one

    92	/-- The outcome of a postprocessed submeasurement is the sum over the fiber of

    94	@[simp] theorem postprocess_outcome {α β ι : Type*}
    95	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq ι]
    96	    (A : SubMeas α ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    97	    (postprocess A f).outcome b =
    98	      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), A.outcome a := by
    99	  classical
   100	  simp only [postprocess]
   101	  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ ?_
   102	  · ext a
   103	    simp
   104	  · intro a _
   105	    rfl

     4	/-!
     5	# Preliminary definitions and statement structures
     6	
     7	This file collects the lightweight statement and definition layer for the
     8	preliminaries chapter of the LDT development. It records the paper's
     9	consistency, sandwich, and completion statements in a form used by later files.
    10	
    11	## Main definitions
    12	
    13	- `BipartiteSDDRel`: the paper-style left/right state-dependent distance
    14	  relation.
    15	- `ConsAgreement`: the measurement reformulation of consistency.
    16	- `ConsSubMeasStmt`, `SwitchSandwichStmt`, `CompTransferStmt`, and
    17	  `CompletingToMeasStmt`: conclusion statements for the main preliminary
    18	  propositions.
    19	- `completeAtOutcome`: completion of a submeasurement at a distinguished
    20	  outcome.
    21	
    22	## References
    23	
    24	- `references/ldt-paper/preliminaries.tex`
    25	-/
    26	
    27	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    28	
    29	namespace MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    30	
    31	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    32	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    33

    30	private theorem directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le
    31	    (D : DirectLdParams) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin D.m) (DirectScalarQ D))
    32	    (hp : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p ≤ D.d) (i : Fin D.m) :
    33	    MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) ≤ D.d := by
    34	  rw [← Fin.rev_rev i,
    35	    MvPolynomial.degreeOf_rename_of_injective Fin.rev_injective]
    36	  exact hp (Fin.rev i)

    38	private theorem ldtPolynomial_ext
    39	    {params : Parameters} [FieldModel params.q]
    40	    {g h : MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params} (hpoly : g.poly = h.poly) : g = h := by
    41	  cases g with
    42	  | mk gp hg =>
    43	      cases h with
    44	      | mk hp hh =>
    45	          simp only at hpoly
    46	          subst hp
    47	          rfl

    49	/-- Bounded QPBT polynomial representatives are equivalent to LDT
    50	polynomial outcomes.  The variable renaming is the same coordinate reversal
    51	as `directPointEquiv`, so evaluation retains the direct coordinate order. -/
    52	noncomputable def directPolyEquivPolynomial (D : DirectLdParams) :
    53	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    54	    PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d ≃
    55	      MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
    56	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    57	  refine
    58	    { toFun := fun g =>
    59	        { poly := MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1
    60	          lowIndividualDegree := directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.1
    61	            (degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc g.2) }
    62	      invFun := fun g =>
    63	        ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.poly, ?_⟩
    64	      left_inv := ?_
    65	      right_inv := ?_ }
    66	  · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
    67	    intro s hs i
    68	    exact (MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mp
    69	      (directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.poly g.lowIndividualDegree i)) s hs
    70	  · intro g
    71	    apply Subtype.ext
    72	    change MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
    73	      (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1) = g.1
    74	    rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
    75	    rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
    76	    exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply g.1
    77	  · intro g
    78	    cases g with
    79	    | mk p hp =>
    80	        have hpoly : MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
    81	            (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) = p := by
    82	          rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
    83	          rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
    84	          exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply p
    85	        apply ldtPolynomial_ext
    86	        exact hpoly

    88	@[simp] theorem directPolyEquivPolynomial_poly
    89	    (D : DirectLdParams) (g : PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d) :
    90	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    91	    (directPolyEquivPolynomial D g).poly = MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1 := by
    92	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

    95	/-- The polynomial equivalence commutes with evaluation after the direct point
    96	and scalar codings. -/
    97	@[simp] theorem directPolyEquivPolynomial_apply
    98	    (D : DirectLdParams) (g : PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
    99	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   100	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   101	    directPolyEquivPolynomial D g (directPointEquiv D u) =
   102	      directScalarEquiv D (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1) := by
   103	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   104	  unfold MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial.toFun evalPolynomialModel
   105	  rw [directPolyEquivPolynomial_poly]
   106	  unfold decodePoint
   107	  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
   108	  congr 1
   109	  apply congrArg (fun v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D =>
   110	    MvPolynomial.eval v g.1)
   111	  funext i
   112	  simp only [Function.comp_apply, directPointEquiv_apply, Fin.rev_rev]
   113	  change (directScalarEquiv D).symm (directScalarEquiv D (u i)) = u i
   114	  exact (directScalarEquiv D).symm_apply_apply (u i)

   118	/-- Regard a complete LDT measurement as a matrix-valued QPBT
   119	measurement, with exactly the same effects. -/
   120	noncomputable def ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement
   121	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   122	    (M : MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) :
   123	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota :=
   124	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne M.outcome M.outcome_pos (by
   125	    rw [M.sum_eq_total, M.total_eq_one])

   128	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   129	    (M : MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) (a : alpha) :
   130	    (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement M).effect a = M.outcome a :=
   131	  rfl

   133	/-- Relabel an LDT polynomial projective measurement by direct QPBT
   134	polynomial representatives. -/
   135	noncomputable def directPolynomialMeasurement
   136	    (D : DirectLdParams) :
   137	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   138	    {iota : Type*} → [Fintype iota] → [DecidableEq iota] →
   139	      ProjMeas (MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota →
   140	        PolyMeas D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d iota := by
   141	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   142	  intro iota _ _ G
   143	  exact matrixMeasurementTransport (directPolyEquivPolynomial D).symm
   144	    (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement G.toMeasurement)

   146	@[simp] theorem directPolynomialMeasurement_effect
   147	    (D : DirectLdParams) :
   148	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   149	    ∀ {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   150	      (G : ProjMeas (MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota)

   152	      (directPolynomialMeasurement D G).effect g =
   153	        G.outcome (directPolyEquivPolynomial D g) := by
   154	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   155	  intro iota _ _ G g
   156	  rfl

   173	/-- Evaluating a direct polynomial tuple and then selecting coordinate `r`
   174	agrees with evaluating the `r`-th polynomial marginal. -/
   175	theorem directPolyMeasTuple_evaluation_marginal
   176	    (D : DirectLdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   177	    (G : DirectPolyMeasTuple D iota) (r : Fin D.k)
   178	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   179	    (G.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).postprocess (fun values => values r) =
   180	      (directPolyMeasTupleMarginal D G r).postprocess
   181	        (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1) := by
   182	  unfold directPolyMeasTupleMarginal

   189	theorem polyMeasTuple_evaluation_marginal
   190	    (L : LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]

   192	    (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
   193	    (G.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).postprocess (fun values => values r) =

   201	/-- Evaluating the transported polynomial measurement is the relabeling of
   202	the LDT evaluation postprocessing through `directScalarEquiv`. -/
   203	theorem directPolynomialMeasurement_evaluation_effect
   204	    (D : DirectLdParams) :
   205	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   206	    ∀ {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   207	      (G : ProjMeas (MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota)
   208	      (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (a : DirectScalarQ D),
   209	      ((directPolynomialMeasurement D G).postprocess
   210	        (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)).effect a =
   211	        (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement
   212	          (ProjMeas.postprocess G
   213	            (fun g => g (directPointEquiv D u))).toMeasurement).effect
   214	            (directScalarEquiv D a) := by
   215	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   216	  intro iota _ _ G u a
   217	  classical
   218	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   219	  rw [ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement_effect,
   220	    ProjMeas.postprocess, SubMeas.postprocess_outcome]
   221	  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun g _ => directPolyEquivPolynomial D g)
   222	  · intro g hg
   223	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hg ⊢
   224	    simpa only [directPolyEquivPolynomial_apply] using
   225	      congrArg (directScalarEquiv D) hg
   226	  · intro g₁ _ g₂ _ h
   227	    exact (directPolyEquivPolynomial D).injective h
   228	  · intro g hg
   229	    refine ⟨(directPolyEquivPolynomial D).symm g, ?_, ?_⟩
   230	    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hg ⊢
   231	      have heval := directPolyEquivPolynomial_apply D
   232	        ((directPolyEquivPolynomial D).symm g) u
   233	      rw [(directPolyEquivPolynomial D).apply_symm_apply] at heval
   234	      exact (directScalarEquiv D).injective (heval.symm.trans hg)
   235	    · exact (directPolyEquivPolynomial D).apply_symm_apply g
   236	  · intro g _
   237	    rw [directPolynomialMeasurement_effect]

    62	    seededLdQuestion_directLdPointQuestionOf]

   101	private theorem correlatedState_compress_left
   102	    {iotaA iotaB block : Type*}
   103	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
   104	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
   106	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
   107	    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((iotaA × block) × (iotaB × block)))
   108	    (hphi : ∀ i j r s, phi ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   109	      if r = s then
   110	        psi (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   111	      else 0)
   112	    (A : Op (iotaA × block)) (B : Op iotaB) :
   113	    DistanceCalculus.stateQForm phi
   114	        (heteroKron A (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => B)) =
   115	      DistanceCalculus.stateQForm psi
   116	        (heteroKron (averageDiagonalBlock A) B) := by
   117	  classical
   118	  unfold DistanceCalculus.stateQForm
   119	  apply congrArg Complex.re
   120	  unfold applyOperatorToState heteroKron Matrix.kronecker averageDiagonalBlock
   121	  simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   122	  simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, dotProduct,
   123	    Matrix.mulVec]
   124	  simp_rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
   125	  suffices h :
   126	      (∑ i : iotaA, ∑ r : block, ∑ j : iotaB,
   127	        ∑ i' : iotaA, ∑ j' : iotaB,
   128	          (starRingEnd ℂ)
   129	              (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
   130	            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
   131	              (B j j' * (A (i, r) (i', r) *
   132	                ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
   133	                  psi (i', j'))))) =
   134	        ∑ i : iotaA, ∑ j : iotaB, ∑ i' : iotaA,
   135	          ∑ j' : iotaB, ∑ r : block,
   136	            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
   137	              (psi (i', j') * (B j j' *
   138	                ((Fintype.card block : ℂ)⁻¹ * A (i, r) (i', r)))) by
   139	    simpa [hphi, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
   140	      apply_ite, map_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
   141	      Finset.mem_univ, if_true, map_mul, Matrix.submatrix,
   142	      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
   143	      mul_assoc, mul_comm] using h

   145	  intro i
   146	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   147	  apply Fintype.sum_congr
   148	  intro j
   149	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   150	  apply Fintype.sum_congr
   151	  intro i'
   152	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   153	  apply Fintype.sum_congr
   154	  intro j'
   155	  apply Fintype.sum_congr
   156	  intro r
   157	  ring_nf
   158	  rw [inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_conj (Fintype.card block)]
   159	  ring

   253	/-- Compressing an arbitrary Alice family preserves its defect against a Bob
   254	family that is constant on the correlated residue register. -/
   255	theorem consistencyDefect_seedFiber_compress_left
   256	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   257	    {X alpha : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
   258	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]

   260	    (A : X → alpha → Op (S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)))

    31	/-- The direct single-coordinate point/global defect is exactly the LDT
    32	defect after the polynomial, point, and scalar equivalences. -/
    33	theorem directPointPolynomial_consistencyDefect_eq
    34	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    35	    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    36	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    37	    ∀ (G : ProjMeas (MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) S.ιB),
    38	      consistencyDefect
    39	          (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    40	          (fun u a => heteroKron
    41	            ((directPointCoordinateMeasurementA D S r u).effect a) 1)
    42	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1
    43	            ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a)) S.ψ =
    44	        consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
    45	          (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    46	          (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ := by
    47	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    48	  intro G
    49	  calc
    50	    consistencyDefect
    51	        (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    52	        (fun u a => heteroKron
    53	          ((directPointCoordinateMeasurementA D S r u).effect a) 1)
    54	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1
    55	          ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a)) S.ψ =
    56	      consistencyDefect
    57	        (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    58	        (fun u a => ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r
    59	          (directPointEquiv D u) (directScalarEquiv D a))
    60	        (fun u a => ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G
    61	          (directPointEquiv D u) (directScalarEquiv D a)) S.ψ := by
    62	          apply consistencyDefect_congr
    63	          · intro u a
    64	            unfold ldtPointAPlaced
    65	            congr 1
    66	            exact (directCoordinatePointMeasurement_effect_transport
    67	              D S hS r u a).symm
    68	          · intro u a
    69	            unfold ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight
    70	            congr 1
    71	            exact directPolynomialMeasurement_evaluation_effect D G u a
    72	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
    73	        (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    74	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ :=
    75	      consistencyDefect_uniform_question_outcome_equiv
    76	        (directPointEquiv D) (directScalarEquiv D)
    77	        (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    78	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ

    80	/-- Convert the point-on-Alice/global-on-Bob conclusion of `LDT.Test.mainFormal`
    81	for one simultaneous coordinate to the direct QPBT defect, with the identical
    82	numerical bound. -/

    84	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    85	    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    86	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    87	    ∀ (G : ProjMeas (MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) S.ιB)
    88	      (delta : ℝ),
    89	      ConsRel (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).state
    90	          (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
    91	          (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
    92	            (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementA)
    93	          (polynomialEvaluationFamily D.toLDTParameters G.toSubMeas) delta →
    94	        consistencyDefect

    99	            ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a))

   113	    (polynomialEvaluationFamily D.toLDTParameters G.toSubMeas) delta
   114	  exact h

239	/-! ## Correlated-ancilla compression -/
   240	
   241	/-!
   242	The diagonal-block conditional expectation preserves either mixed defect
   243	exactly because the point measurement on the opposite carrier is constant on
   244	the residue register.  It does not yield a global/global compression theorem:
   245	the lifted state pairs equal residues, whereas separately compressing both
   246	polynomial measurements produces an independent double average over residues.
   247	Neither quantity bounds the other in general.  This open obstruction is
   248	recorded in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
   249	-/
   250	
   251	/-- The normalized diagonal-block average of an operator on a carrier with a
   252	finite ancillary register.  This is the local conditional expectation used to
   253	discard one half of the correlated seed-residue ancilla. -/
   254	noncomputable def averageDiagonalBlock
   255	    {iota block : Type*} [Fintype iota] [Fintype block]
   256	    (A : Op (iota × block)) : Op iota := by
   257	  classical
   258	  exact (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
   259	    ∑ r, A.submatrix (fun i => (i, r)) (fun i => (i, r))
   260	
   261	/-- Compress a POVM through the normalized diagonal-block average.  The
   262	nonemptiness assumption says precisely that the normalized finite average is
   263	defined over at least one ancillary basis element. -/
   264	noncomputable def correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement
   265	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   266	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   267	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
   268	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block)) :
   269	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota :=
   270	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   271	    (fun a => averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a))
   272	    (fun a => by
   273	      unfold averageDiagonalBlock
   274	      apply smul_nonneg
   275	      · positivity
   276	      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ =>
   277	          Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
   278	            ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix
   279	              (fun i => (i, r))))
   280	    (by
   281	      classical
   282	      ext i j
   283	      simp only [averageDiagonalBlock, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
   284	        Matrix.submatrix_apply]
   285	      calc
   286	        ∑ a, (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
   287	              ∑ r, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) =
   288	            (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
   289	              ∑ a, ∑ r, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) := by
   290	                rw [Finset.smul_sum]
   291	        _ = (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
   292	              ∑ r, ∑ a, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) := by
   293	                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   294	        _ = (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
   295	              ∑ r, (1 : Op (iota × block)) (i, r) (j, r) := by
   296	                congr 1
   297	                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   298	                intro r _
   299	                simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
   300	                  congrFun (congrFun M.sum_eq_one (i, r)) (j, r)
   301	        _ = (1 : Op iota) i j := by
   302	              simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.card_ne_zero])
   303	
   304	@[simp] theorem correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement_effect
   305	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   306	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   307	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
   308	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block)) (a : alpha) :
   309	    (correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement M).effect a =
   310	      averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a) :=
   311	  rfl
   312	
   313	private theorem averageDiagonalBlock_finset_sum
   314	    {alpha iota block : Type*} [Fintype iota] [Fintype block]
   315	    (s : Finset alpha) (A : alpha → Op (iota × block)) :
   316	    averageDiagonalBlock (∑ a ∈ s, A a) =
   317	      ∑ a ∈ s, averageDiagonalBlock (A a) := by
   318	  classical
   319	  ext i j
   320	  simp only [averageDiagonalBlock, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
   321	    Matrix.submatrix_apply]
   322	  simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum]
   323	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   324	
   325	/-- Normalized diagonal-block compression commutes with deterministic outcome
   326	postprocessing. -/
   327	theorem correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement_postprocess
   328	    {alpha beta iota block : Type*}
   329	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   330	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   331	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   332	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
   333	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block))
   334	    (f : alpha → beta) :
   335	    correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement (M.postprocess f) =
   336	      (correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement M).postprocess f := by
   337	  classical
   338	  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
   339	  intro b
   340	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   341	    correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement_effect,
   342	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   343	  exact averageDiagonalBlock_finset_sum
   344	    (Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b)) M.effect
   345	
   346	/-- Specialize ancillary compression to the nonempty residue fiber supplied by
   347	the divisibility data of `LdParams`. -/
   348	noncomputable def seedFiberCompressMeasurement
   349	    (L : LdParams) {alpha iota : Type*}
   350	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   351	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha
   352	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
   353	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota := by
   354	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   355	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   356	  exact correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement M
   357	
   358	@[simp] theorem seedFiberCompressMeasurement_effect
   359	    (L : LdParams) {alpha iota : Type*}
   360	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   361	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha
   362	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (a : alpha) :
   363	    (seedFiberCompressMeasurement L M).effect a =
   364	      averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a) :=
   365	  rfl
   366	
   367	/-- Seed-fiber compression commutes with deterministic outcome
   368	postprocessing. -/
   369	theorem seedFiberCompressMeasurement_postprocess
   370	    (L : LdParams) {alpha beta iota : Type*}
   371	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   372	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   373	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   374	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha
   375	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (f : alpha → beta) :
   376	    seedFiberCompressMeasurement L (M.postprocess f) =
   377	      (seedFiberCompressMeasurement L M).postprocess f := by
   378	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   379	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   380	  exact correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement_postprocess M f
   381	
   382	/-- Compress a direct polynomial-tuple POVM from the correlated seed-residue
   383	carrier to the corresponding seed-indexed polynomial POVM. -/
   384	noncomputable def seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple
   385	    (L : LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   386	    (G : DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
   387	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) : PolyMeasTuple L iota := by
   388	  exact seedFiberCompressMeasurement L G
   389	
   390	@[simp] theorem seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple_effect
   391	    (L : LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   392	    (G : DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
   393	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (g : PolyTuple L) :
   394	    (seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple L G).effect g =
   395	      averageDiagonalBlock (G.effect g) :=
   396	  rfl
   397	
   398	/-- Polynomial evaluation commutes exactly with compression of the correlated
   399	seed-residue carrier. -/
   400	theorem seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple_evaluation
   401	    (L : LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   402	    (G : DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
   403	      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
   404	    (seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple L G).postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u) =
   405	      seedFiberCompressMeasurement L
   406	        (G.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)) := by
   407	  exact (seedFiberCompressMeasurement_postprocess L G
   408	    (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).symm
   409	
   410	/-- Block-diagonal assembly commutes with deterministic outcome
   411	postprocessing. -/
   412	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_postprocess
   413	    {alpha beta iota block : Type*}
   414	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   415	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   416	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   417	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   418	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   419	    (f : alpha → beta) :
   420	    (blockDiagonalMeasurement M).postprocess f =
   421	      blockDiagonalMeasurement (fun r => (M r).postprocess f) := by
   422	  classical
   423	  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
   424	  intro b
   425	  ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
   426	  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   427	    blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect, Matrix.sum_apply,
   428	    Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
   429	  by_cases hrs : r = s
   430	  · subst s
   431	    simp only [if_pos]
   432	  · simp [hrs]
   433	
   434	private theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_eq_postprocess
   435	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
   436	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   437	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   438	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   439	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
   440	    matrixMeasurementTransport e M = M.postprocess e := by
   441	  classical
   442	  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
   443	  intro b
   444	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   445	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (e.symm b)]
   446	  · simp
   447	  · intro a haMem ha
   448	    have hea : e a = b := (Finset.mem_filter.mp haMem).2
   449	    exact (ha (e.injective (hea.trans (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm))).elim
   450	  · simp
   451	
   452	/-- Relabeling along an outcome equivalence commutes with subsequent
   453	postprocessing. -/
   454	theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_postprocess
   455	    {alpha beta gamma iota : Type*}
   456	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   457	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   458	    [Fintype gamma] [DecidableEq gamma]
   459	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   460	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   461	    (f : beta → gamma) :
   462	    (matrixMeasurementTransport e M).postprocess f =
   463	      M.postprocess (fun a => f (e a)) := by
   464	  rw [matrixMeasurementTransport_eq_postprocess,
   465	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   466	
   467	end
   468	
   469	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    31	/-- The direct single-coordinate point/global defect is exactly the LDT
    32	defect after the polynomial, point, and scalar equivalences. -/
    33	theorem directPointPolynomial_consistencyDefect_eq
    34	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    35	    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    36	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

    38	      consistencyDefect
    39	          (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    40	          (fun u a => heteroKron
    41	            ((directPointCoordinateMeasurementA D S r u).effect a) 1)
    42	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1
    43	            ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a)) S.ψ =

    45	          (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    46	          (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ := by

    48	  intro G
    49	  calc
    50	    consistencyDefect
    51	        (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    52	        (fun u a => heteroKron

    54	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1
    55	          ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a)) S.ψ =

    58	        (fun u a => ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r

    60	        (fun u a => ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G
    61	          (directPointEquiv D u) (directScalarEquiv D a)) S.ψ := by
    62	          apply consistencyDefect_congr
    63	          · intro u a
    64	            unfold ldtPointAPlaced
    65	            congr 1
    66	            exact (directCoordinatePointMeasurement_effect_transport
    67	              D S hS r u a).symm
    68	          · intro u a

    71	            exact directPolynomialMeasurement_evaluation_effect D G u a

    73	        (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    74	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ :=
    75	      consistencyDefect_uniform_question_outcome_equiv
    76	        (directPointEquiv D) (directScalarEquiv D)
    77	        (ldtPointAPlaced D S hS r)
    78	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationRight D G) S.ψ

    80	/-- Convert the point-on-Alice/global-on-Bob conclusion of `LDT.Test.mainFormal`
    81	for one simultaneous coordinate to the direct QPBT defect, with the identical

    83	theorem directPointPolynomial_consistencyDefect_le
    84	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    85	    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :

    88	      (delta : ℝ),

    90	          (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
    91	          (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas
    92	            (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementA)
    93	          (polynomialEvaluationFamily D.toLDTParameters G.toSubMeas) delta →
    94	        consistencyDefect

    96	          (fun u a => heteroKron

    99	            ((directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).effect a))
   100	          S.ψ ≤ delta := by

   102	  intro G delta h

   114	  exact h

   154	            congr 1
   155	            exact (directCoordinatePointMeasurementB_effect_transport
   156	              D S hS r u a).symm
   157	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
   158	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationLeft D G)
   159	        (ldtPointBPlaced D S hS r) S.ψ :=
   160	      consistencyDefect_uniform_question_outcome_equiv
   161	        (directPointEquiv D) (directScalarEquiv D)
   162	        (ldtPolynomialEvaluationLeft D G)

   164	
   165	/-- Convert the global-on-Alice/point-on-Bob conclusion of
   166	`LDT.Test.mainFormal` for one simultaneous coordinate to the direct QPBT
   167	defect, with the identical numerical bound. -/
   168	theorem directPolynomialPoint_consistencyDefect_le
   169	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   170	    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
   171	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

    29	/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/

    31	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    33	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    34	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
    35	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    36	    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))

    39	      calc
    40	        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=

    48	    (b : beta) :

   101	/-- A block-diagonal family of projective measurements is projective. -/
   102	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   103	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   104	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   106	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   107	    (hM : ∀ r, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M r)) :
   108	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockDiagonalMeasurement M) := by
   109	  intro a
   110	  constructor
   111	  · change Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) *
   112	        Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) =
   113	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   114	    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
   115	    congr 1
   116	    funext r
   117	    exact (hM r a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   118	  · change (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a))ᴴ =
   119	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   120	    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose]
   121	    congr 1
   122	    funext r

   125	/-! ## The correlated residue state -/
   126	
   127	/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
   128	residue. -/
   129	noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : LdParams) :
   130	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   131	      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
   132	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   133	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   134	  exact eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   135	
   136	/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
   137	theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : LdParams) :
   138	    ‖seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
   139	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   140	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   141	  exact eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   142	
   143	/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm. -/
   144	theorem reindexState_norm_eq
   145	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   147	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]
   188	
   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
   192	question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
   193	canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   195	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   206	  ψ := seedFiberLiftedState S L
   207	  ψ_norm := seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
   208	  A q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   214	
   215	/-- Projectivity is preserved by the correlated seed-fiber dilation. -/
   216	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_isProjective (L : LdParams)
   217	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (hS : S.IsProjective) :
   218	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).IsProjective := by
   219	  constructor
   220	  · intro q
   221	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   222	    intro residue
   223	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   224	    exact hS.1 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   225	  · intro q
   226	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   227	    intro residue
   228	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   229	    exact hS.2 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   230	
   231	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_A_effect (L : LdParams)
   232	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   233	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   234	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   235	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A q).effect answer =
   236	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   237	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   238	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   239	  rfl
   240	
   241	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_B_effect (L : LdParams)
   242	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   243	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   244	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   245	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B q).effect answer =
   246	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   247	        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   248	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   249	  rfl

   251	/-- A direct question reconstructed in a residue block parses back to its
   252	canonical direct form. -/
   253	theorem parse_seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   254	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   255	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   256	    parseLdQuestion L (seededLdQuestion L q residue) =
   257	      (q.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams q.1 q.2) := by
   258	  exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L q.1 q.2 residue
   259	
   260	/-- Coordinate formula for the correlated residue lift. -/
   261	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_apply
   262	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   263	    (i : S.ιA) (j : S.ιB)
   264	    (r s : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   265	    seedFiberLiftedState S L ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   266	      if r = s then
   267	        S.ψ (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   268	      else 0 := by
   269	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   270	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   271	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState, vecTensor, seedResidueAncilla,
   272	    eprState, prodShuffle]

1	\section{The test}\label{sec:the-test}
     2	
     3	\begin{definition}[Roles]
     4	The low individual degree test will be played between two provers and a verifier.
     5	The two provers are named Player~$\mathrm{A}$ and Player~$\mathrm{B}$.
     6	A \emph{role} $r$ is an element of the set $\{\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}\}$.
     7	Given a role~$r$, we write $\overline{r}$ for the other element of the set $\{\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}\}$.
     8	\end{definition}
     9	
    10	\begin{definition}[Low individual degree test]
    11	Let~$m$ and~$d$ be nonnegative integers.
    12	Let $q$ be a prime power.
    13	Then the \emph{$(m,q,d)$-low individual degree test}
    14	is stated in \Cref{fig:test}.
    15	\end{definition}
    16	
    17	{
    18	\floatstyle{boxed} 
    19	\restylefloat{figure}
    20	\begin{figure}
    21	With probability~$\tfrac{1}{3}$ each, perform one of the following three tests.
    22	\begin{enumerate}
    23		\item \textbf{Axis-parallel lines test:}
    24			Pick a uniformly random role $\br \sim \{\mathrm{A},\mathrm{B}\}$.
    25			Let $\bu \sim \F_q^m$ be a uniformly random point.
    26			Select $\bi \sim \{1, \ldots, m\}$ uniformly at random,
    27			and let $\bell = \{\bu + t \cdot e_{\bi} \mid t \in \F_q\}$
    28			be the axis-parallel line which passes through~$\bu$ in the $\bi$-th direction.
    29			\begin{itemize}
    30			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\br$: 
    31				Give $\bell$;
    32				receive the univariate degree-$d$ polynomial $\boldf:\bell \rightarrow \F_q$.
    33			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\overline{\br}$:
    34				Give $\bu$;
    35				receive $\ba \in \F_q$.
    36			\end{itemize}
    37			Accept if $\boldf(\bu) = \ba$.
    38		\item \textbf{Self-consistency test:}
    39			Let $\bu \sim \F_q^m$ be a uniformly random point.
    40			\begin{itemize}
    41			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\mathrm{A}$: 
    42				Give $\bu$;
    43				receive $\ba \in \F_q$.
    44			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\mathrm{B}$:
    45				Give $\bu$;
    46				receive $\bb \in \F_q$.
    47			\end{itemize}
    48			Accept if $\ba = \bb$.
    49		\item \textbf{Diagonal lines test:}
    50			Pick a uniformly random role $\br \sim \{\mathrm{A},\mathrm{B}\}$.
    51			Let $\bu \sim \F_q^m$ be a uniformly random point.
    52			Select $\bi \sim \{1, \ldots, m\}$ uniformly at random,
    53			and let $\bv \in \F_q^m$ be a uniformly random point whose last $m - \bi$ coordinates are~$0$.
    54			Finally,
    55			let $\bell = \{\bu + t \cdot \bv \mid t \in \F_q\}$
    56			be the line which passes through~$\bu$ in direction~$\bv$.
    57			\begin{itemize}
    58			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\br$: 
    59				Give $\bell$;
    60				receive the univariate degree-$md$ polynomial $\boldf:\bell \rightarrow \F_q$.
    61			\item[$\circ$] Player~$\overline{\br}$:
    62				Give $\bu$;
    63				receive $\ba \in \F_q$.
    64			\end{itemize}
    65			Accept if $\boldf(\bu) = \ba$.
    66		\end{enumerate}
    67		\caption{The $(m,q,d)$-low individual degree test.\label{fig:test}}
    68	\end{figure}
    69	}
    70	
    71	An important class of strategies are those which are \emph{symmetric}.
    72	In this case, the bipartite state $\ket{\psi}$ Alice and Bob share is symmetric.
    73	Furthermore, for any question Alice and Bob receive, they apply the same measurement to their share of the state.
    74	This means that rather than, for example, keeping track of a separate points measurement for Alice and Bob,
    75	we can use a single measurement to refer to both of their strategies,
    76	and similarly for the axis-parallel lines and diagonal lines measurements.
    77	This is formalized in the following definition, where we also consider strategies which are projective.
    78	
    79	\begin{definition}[Symmetric, projective strategy]
    80	A \emph{symmetric, projective strategy} for the $(m,q, d)$-low individual degree test
    81	is a tuple $(\psi, A, B, L)$ defined as follows.
    82	\begin{itemize}
    83	\item[$\circ$] $\ket{\psi} \in \calH \ot \calH$ is a bipartite, permutation-invariant state.
    84	\item[$\circ$] $A = \{A^u_a\}$ contains a matrix for each $u \in \F_q^m$ and $a \in \F_q$.
    85				For each $u$, $A^u$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH$.
    86	\item[$\circ$] $B = \{B^{\ell}_f\}$ contains a matrix for each axis-parallel line~$\ell$ in $\F_q^m$
    87				and univariate degree-$d$ polynomial $f:\ell\rightarrow \F_q$.
    88				For each $\ell$, $B^{\ell}$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH$.
    89	\item[$\circ$] $L = \{L^{\ell}_f\}$ contains a matrix for each line~$\ell$ in $\F_q^m$
    90				and univariate degree-$md$ polynomial $f:\ell\rightarrow \F_q$.
    91				For each $\ell$, $L^{\ell}$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH$.
    92	\end{itemize}
    93	\end{definition}
    94	
    95	We can also consider more general strategies which are no longer assumed to be symmetric.
    96	In this case, Players~$\mathrm{A}$ and~$\mathrm{B}$ each have their own versions of the measurements~$A$, $B$, and~$L$.
    97	
    98	\begin{definition}[General projective strategy]
    99	A \emph{projective strategy} for the $(m,q, d)$-low individual degree test
   100	is a tuple $(\psi, A^{\mathrm{A}},B^{\mathrm{A}},L^{\mathrm{A}},A^{\mathrm{B}},B^{\mathrm{B}},L^{\mathrm{B}})$ defined as follows.
   101	\begin{itemize}
   102	\item[$\circ$] $\ket{\psi} \in \calH_{\mathrm{A}} \ot \calH_{\mathrm{B}}$ is a bipartite state.
   103	\end{itemize}
   104	Furthermore, for each~$w \in \{\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}\}$:
   105	\begin{itemize}
   106	\item[$\circ$] $A^{w} = \{A^{w,u}_a\}$ contains a matrix for each $u \in \F_q^m$ and $a \in \F_q$.
   107				For each $u$, $A^{w,u}$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH_{w}$.
   108	\item[$\circ$] $B^{w} = \{B^{w,\ell}_f\}$ contains a matrix for each axis-parallel line~$\ell$ in $\F_q^m$
   109				and univariate degree-$d$ polynomial $f:\ell\rightarrow \F_q$.
   110				For each $\ell$, $B^{w,\ell}$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH_{w}$.
   111	\item[$\circ$] $L^w = \{L^{w,\ell}_f\}$ contains a matrix for each line~$\ell$ in $\F_q^m$
   112				and univariate degree-$md$ polynomial $f:\ell\rightarrow \F_q$.
   113				For each $\ell$, $L^{w,\ell}$ is a projective measurement on~$\calH_{w}$.
   114	\end{itemize}
   115	\end{definition}
   116	
   117	\begin{remark}
   118	Throughout this work, we will only consider projective strategies.
   119	So we will henceforth use the terms ``strategy" and ``symmetric strategy'' to refer exclusively to projective strategies and symmetric, projective strategies, respectively.
   120	
   121	In addition, we will spend the vast majority of this work dealing solely with symmetric strategies, as they are notationally simpler to work with.
   122	Much of this work will focus on proving~\Cref{thm:main-induction},
   123	a variant of our main theorem for symmetric strategies.
   124	Our main theorem for general strategies, \Cref{thm:main-formal} below, will be proven in \Cref{sec:induction} by a standard reduction to the symmetric case.
   125	We will only see these more cumbersome-to-write general strategies
   126	in this section, where we state \Cref{thm:main-formal},
   127	and in \Cref{sec:induction}, where we carry out the reduction.
   128	\end{remark}
   129	
   130	\begin{definition}[Good strategy]
   131	A strategy is $(\eps, \delta, \gamma)$-good if it
   132	passes the axis-parallel lines test with probability at least $1-\eps$,
   133	the self consistency test with probability at least~$1-\delta$,
   134	and the diagonal lines test with probability at least~$1-\gamma$.
   135	\end{definition}
   136	
   137	\begin{remark}\label{rem:good-strat-characterization}
   138	Using notation which will be introduced in \Cref{sec:comparing-measurements} below,
   139	a symmetric strategy is $(\eps, \delta, \gamma)$-good
   140	if and only if it satisfies the following three conditions.
   141	For $\bell$ and $\bu$ as in the axis-parallel lines test,
   142	\begin{equation*}
   143	A^u_a \ot I \simeq_{\eps} I \ot B^{\ell}_{[f(u)=a]},
   144	\quad
   145	\text{and}
   146	\quad
   147	A^u_a \ot I \simeq_{\delta} I \ot A^u_a.
   148	\end{equation*}
   149	And for $\bell$ and $\bu$ as in the diagonal lines test,
   150	\begin{equation*}
   151	A^u_a \ot I \simeq_{\gamma} I \ot L^{\ell}_{[f(u)=a]}.
   152	\end{equation*}
   153	\end{remark}
   154	
   155	\begin{notation}\label{not:conditioned-on-last-direction}
   156	Our proof will be via induction,
   157	i.e.\ proving soundness of the $(m+1,q,d)$-low individual degree test
   158	using the soundness of the $(m,q,d)$-low individual degree test.
   159	To do this, we will frequently use the axis-parallel line test in the specific case of $i = m+1$.
   160	Thus, it will be convenient to introduce the following notation.
   161	Let $(\psi, A, B, L)$ be a symmetric strategy for the $(m+1, q, d)$-low individual degree test,
   162	Then for each $u \in \F_q^m$ we will write $B^u_f$ as shorthand for $B^{\ell}_f$,
   163	where $\ell = \{(u, x) \mid x \in \F_q\}$.
   164	For a function $f:\ell \rightarrow \F_q$,
   165	we will also sometimes write $f(x)$ as shorthand for $f(u,x)$.
   166	\end{notation}
   167	
   168	\begin{definition}
   169	Consider the $(m,q,d)$-low individual degree test.
   170	For $j \in \{1, \ldots, m\}$,
   171	we refer to the \emph{$j$-restricted diagonal lines test}
   172	as the diagonal lines test conditioned on $\bi = j$.
   173	For example, in the $m$-restricted diagonal lines test,
   174	the line $\bell$ is simply a uniformly random line in $\F_q^m$.
   175	\end{definition}
   176	
   177	Now we state our main theorem using notation which will be introduced in \Cref{sec:prelims} below.
   178	This the formal version of \Cref{thm:main-informal}.
   179	
   180	\begin{theorem}[Main theorem; quantum soundness of the low individual degree test]\label{thm:main-formal}
   181	  Consider a projective strategy $(\psi, A^{\mathrm{A}},B^{\mathrm{A}},L^{\mathrm{A}},A^{\mathrm{B}},B^{\mathrm{B}},L^{\mathrm{B}})$ 
   182	   which passes the  $(m,q,d)$-low individual degree test with probability at least $1-\eps$.
   183	  Let $k \geq md$ be an integer.
   184	  Let
   185	  \begin{equation*}
   186	  \nu = 100000 k^2m^4 \cdot \Big(\eps^{1/40000} + (d/q)^{1/40000} + e^{-k/(2560000m^2)}\Big).
   187	  \end{equation*}
   188	Then there exists projective measurements $G^{\mathrm{A}}, G^{\mathrm{B}} \in \polymeas{m}{q}{d}$ with the following properties:
   189	\begin{enumerate}
   190	  \item (Consistency with~$A$):  On average over $\bu \sim \F_q^{m}$,
   191		  \begin{align*}
   192		  A^{\mathrm{A},u}_a \otimes I
   193		  	&\simeq_{\nu} I \otimes G^{\mathrm{B}}_{[g(u)=a]},\\
   194		I \otimes A^{\mathrm{B},u}_a
   195		  	&\simeq_{\nu}  G^{\mathrm{A}}_{[g(u)=a]} \ot I.
   196		  \end{align*}
   197	\item (Self-consistency):
   198		\begin{equation*}
   199		G^{\mathrm{A}}_g \ot I \simeq_{\nu} I \ot G^{\mathrm{B}}_g.
   200		\end{equation*}
   201	\end{enumerate}
   202	\end{theorem}
   203	
   204	We note that there is a tradeoff in \Cref{thm:main-formal} specified by the parameter~$k$.
   205	As~$k$ increases, $\nu$'s prefactor $k^2$ increases.
   206	On the other hand, as $k$ increases, the term $e^{- k/(2560000m^2)}$ which also occurs in $\nu$ \emph{decreases}.
   207	Thus, when applying this theorem, one must select~$k$ to balance these competing demands.
   208	Typically, choosing $k = \poly(m)$ should be more than sufficient for applications.
   209	We believe that this parameter~$k$ is an artifact of our proof,
   210	and we hope that it will be removed in the future.
